direct_official_checks: points are collected on flat unambiguous surfaces
each ground-truth point has +/-3cm RMSE accuracy
ground-truth metadata includes survey date and method
ground-truth may be reused subject to age rules
LIDAR survey QC compares RMSE standard deviation and random error
LIDAR must report less than +/-15cm RMSE and 10cm standard deviation/random error to pass QC
ground-truth point accuracy is QC evidence not parcel elevation accuracy
quality_effect: Uses independent ground truth only as survey-QC evidence and prevents its 3cm point accuracy from being promoted to parcel-height accuracy.
